description: Mia AI Lab's exact two-Spark TensorFold kit (BertholomusAI's engine fork with the kit's verbatim patch series; the pins live in the recipe's source reference and kit lock): EAQ v1 EXL3 2.9 bpw checkpoint, 262,144-token shared pool, four streams, target-only decoding, image input, thinking on, and required/named tool-choice enforcement. Carries the kit's verbatim engine patch series (the optional spill tier, KV sharding and EAQ v1.1 mixed-pack features stay off or unused: EAQ v1 remains the default, as in the kit) with kept prompt snapshots disabled. Uses Mia's digest-pinned ARM64 image with its exact serving fork, auxiliary rank-cache tools and patches, plus the pinned kernel kit. Controller-managed read-only models and local Engram shards replace upstream SSH/NFS setup; durable per-rank derived inputs use /outputs/cache. The former 115 GiB declaration combined upstream's 98.9 GiB rank weights with a misidentified 12.2 GiB runtime allowance: 12.2 GiB is the engine's free-memory reserve, not an allocation. This is an estimate; physical qualification on this fleet is pending. The optional gated abliterated overlay is not included. Admission repair: --no-drafts skips DSpark weight loading and draft buffers on BOTH ranks (weights.zig::load, model.zig::open); credit only 3 GiB of the creator's approximately 3.5 GiB draft weights. Reducing --context/--pool from 1,048,576 to 262,144 removes at least another 1 GiB: prompt.zig::Caches.init uses 890 bytes/position (KV sources 2/8/14 at ratio 2 and 20 at ratio 1, packed 512-wide FP4 plus scales and 128-wide index keys), and model.zig allocates 512 RoPE bytes/position; 786,432 * 1,402 = 1,102,577,664 bytes removed, before smaller round/index workspace. Keep the remaining original allowance: 115 - 3 - 1 = 111 GiB (119,185,342,464 bytes) peak/rank. --prompt-cache-gib=0 prevents additional kept-state snapshots. Engram remains disk-backed, no CPU offload or RAM-fraction cap is substituted. This is a conservative source-backed planning estimate, not measured fleet acceptance.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 EAQ 2.9bpw TensorFold TP2 (Mia)
